templates.title: Borg UI
templates.name: borg-ui
templates.description: Web interface for BorgBackup. Run backups, browse and restore archives, manage local, SSH and SFTP repositories and automate schedules. Single container, no Redis (in-memory archive cache).
templates.note: Login as admin with the initial admin password you set (default admin123) and change it. Map the folders you want to back up to /local. Redis is optional: set REDIS_URL to an existing Redis to enable a persistent archive cache. Archive mounting and SSHFS pull backups need FUSE (SYS_ADMIN + /dev/fuse); use the stack template or docs for that. Docs: https://docs.borgui.com/installation

env.name: PORT
env.label: Listen port
env.description: Must match the container side of the 8081 port mapping.

env.name: PUID
env.label: PUID
env.description: User ID that owns backup files.

env.name: PGID
env.label: PGID
env.description: Group ID that owns backup files.

env.name: LOCAL_MOUNT_POINTS
env.label: Local mount points
env.description: Comma-separated container paths shown in the file browser.

env.name: INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Initial admin password
env.description: Used on first start only. Leave empty for the app default (admin123).

env.name: REDIS_HOST
env.label: Redis host
env.description: Leave 'disabled' for the in-memory cache, or set a Redis hostname.

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.label: Redis URL (optional)
env.description: Full Redis URL, e.g. redis://192.168.1.10:6379/0. Overrides REDIS_HOST.

templates.title: Borg UI + Redis
templates.name: borg-ui-redis
templates.description: Borg UI with a bundled Redis cache for faster, persistent archive browsing. Compose stack (Borg UI + redis:7-alpine).
templates.note: Set LOCAL_STORAGE_PATH to the host folder to back up (mounted at /local). Login as admin with INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD (default admin123). To enable FUSE for archive mounting, uncomment the cap_add/devices/security_opt lines in the stack file, see https://docs.borgui.com/installation#optional-fuse-access

env.name: LOCAL_STORAGE_PATH
env.label: Host folder to back up
env.description: Mounted read-write at /local inside the container.

env.name: INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: Initial admin password
env.description: Used on first start only. Leave empty for the app default (admin123).

env.name: REDIS_MAXMEMORY
env.label: Redis max memory
env.description: Upper bound for the Redis cache (allkeys-lru eviction).
